+#!/usr/bin/python
+# Copyright: Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1', 'status': ['preview'], 'supported_by': 'community'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = '''
+---
+module: icx_logging
+version_added: "2.9"
+short_description: Manage logging on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches
+description:
+  - Configure ICX logging destinations, facilities and buffered levels.
+author: Ansible Project
+options:
+  dest:
+    description: Logging destination or feature.
+    type: str
+    choices: [host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424, on, facility]
+  name:
+    description: Syslog host name or IP address. Required for host destinations.
+    type: str
+  udp_port:
+    description: UDP port for a syslog host.
+    type: int
+  facility:
+    description: Syslog facility to set or clear.
+    type: str
+  level:
+    description: Buffered logging severity level. Required for buffered destinations.
+    type: str
+    choices: [alerts, critical, debugging, emergencies, errors, informational, notifications, warnings]
+  aggregate:
+    description: List of logging settings to reconcile in one operation.
+    type: list
+    elements: dict
+    suboptions:
+      dest:
+        type: str
+        choices: [host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424, on, facility]
+      name:
+        type: str
+      udp_port:
+        type: int
+      facility:
+        type: str
+      level:
+        type: str
+        choices: [alerts, critical, debugging, emergencies, errors, informational, notifications, warnings]
+      state:
+        type: str
+        choices: [present, absent]
+  state:
+    description: Desired state of the specified setting.
+    type: str
+    default: present
+    choices: [present, absent]
+  check_running_config:
+    description: Compare desired settings with the running configuration.
+    type: bool
+    default: true
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Configure an IPv6 syslog destination
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: host
+    name: '2001:db8::1'
+    udp_port: 5514
+
+- name: Configure facility and buffered level together
+  icx_logging:
+    aggregate:
+      - facility: local0
+      - dest: buffered
+        level: alerts
+'''
+
+RETURN = '''
+commands:
+  description: Configuration commands sent to the switch.
+  returned: always
+  type: list
+  sample: ['logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514']
+'''
+
+import re
+from ipaddress import ip_address
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule, env_fallback
+from ansible.module_utils.network.icx.icx import get_config, load_config
+
+LEVELS = frozenset(('alerts', 'critical', 'debugging', 'emergencies', 'errors',
+                    'informational', 'notifications', 'warnings'))
+
+
+def count_terms(check, param=None):
+    return sum(check.get(key) is not None for key in (param or check))
+
+
+def search_obj_in_list(name, lst):
+    for obj in lst:
+        if obj.get('name') == name:
+            return obj
+    return None
+
+
+def diff_in_list(want, have):
+    return set(want) - set(have), set(have) - set(want)
+
+
+def check_required_if(module, spec, param):
+    for key, value, required in spec:
+        if param.get(key) == value:
+            for field in required:
+                if not param.get(field):
+                    module.fail_json(msg='%s is required when %s is %s' % (field, key, value))
+
+
+def _is_ipv6(value):
+    try:
+        return ip_address(value).version == 6
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+
+
+def map_params_to_obj(module, required_if=None):
+    required_if = required_if or [('dest', 'host', ['name']),
+                                  ('dest', 'buffered', ['level']),
+                                  ('dest', 'facility', ['facility'])]
+    params = module.params
+    entries = params.get('aggregate') or [params]
+    result = []
+    for entry in entries:
+        item = {key: entry.get(key) if entry.get(key) is not None else params.get(key)
+                for key in ('dest', 'name', 'udp_port', 'facility', 'level', 'state')}
+        if item['dest'] is None and item['facility'] is not None:
+            item['dest'] = 'facility'
+        if item['dest'] is None:
+            module.fail_json(msg='dest or facility is required')
+        if not (item['dest'] == 'facility' and item.get('state') == 'absent'):
+            check_required_if(module, required_if, item)
+        item['state'] = item['state'] or 'present'
+        if item['dest'] == 'host':
+            if ':' in item['name'] and not _is_ipv6(item['name']):
+                module.fail_json(msg='invalid IPv6 host address: %s' % item['name'])
+            item['addr6'] = _is_ipv6(item['name'])
+            item['udp_port'] = str(item['udp_port']) if item['udp_port'] is not None else None
+        else:
+            item['name'] = None
+            item['udp_port'] = None
+            item['addr6'] = False
+        if item['dest'] == 'buffered':
+            item['level'] = set(item['level']) if isinstance(item['level'], (list, set, tuple)) else {item['level']}
+            if not item['level'].issubset(LEVELS):
+                module.fail_json(msg='invalid buffered logging level')
+        elif item['dest'] != 'console':
+            item['level'] = None
+        result.append(item)
+    return result
+
+
+def parse_port(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host':
+        match = re.search(r'\budp-port\s+(\d+)\b', line)
+        return match.group(1) if match else None
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_name(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host':
+        match = re.match(r'^logging host (?:ipv6 )?(\S+)', line.strip())
+        return match.group(1) if match else None
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_address(line, dest):
+    return dest == 'host' and bool(re.match(r'^logging host ipv6 \S+', line.strip()))
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    data = get_config(module, flags=['| include logging'],
+                      compare=module.params.get('check_running_config'))
+    obj = []
+    facility = 'user'
+    buffered = None
+    disabled = set()
+    global_off = False
+    for raw in data.splitlines():
+        line = raw.strip()
+        if line.startswith('logging host '):
+            obj.append(dict(dest='host', name=parse_name(line, 'host'),
+                            udp_port=parse_port(line, 'host'), addr6=parse_address(line, 'host')))
+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):
+            facility = line.split(None, 2)[2]
+        elif line == 'no logging facility':
+            facility = 'user'
+        elif line == 'no logging on':
+            global_off = True
+        elif line == 'logging on':
+            global_off = False
+        elif line == 'logging buffered':
+            buffered = set(LEVELS)
+        elif line.startswith('logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[-1]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                if buffered is None:
+                    buffered = set()
+                buffered.add(level)
+        elif line == 'no logging buffered':
+            buffered = None
+        elif line.startswith('no logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[-1]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                disabled.add(level)
+                if buffered is not None:
+                    buffered.discard(level)
+        elif re.match(r'^logging console(?: \S+)?$', line):
+            parts = line.split()
+            obj.append(dict(dest='console', level=parts[2] if len(parts) == 3 else None))
+        elif line == 'logging persistence':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='persistence'))
+        elif line == 'logging enable rfc5424':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='rfc5424'))
+    if buffered is not None:
+        obj.append(dict(dest='buffered', level=buffered - disabled))
+    obj.append(dict(dest='facility', facility=facility))
+    if not global_off:
+        obj.append(dict(dest='on'))
+    return obj
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    for item in want:
+        dest = item['dest']
+        state = item.get('state', 'present')
+        current = [entry for entry in have if entry['dest'] == dest]
+        if dest == 'host':
+            name = item['name']
+            matches = [entry for entry in current if entry.get('name') == name and
+                       entry.get('addr6', False) == item.get('addr6', False)]
+            port = item.get('udp_port')
+            prefix = 'logging host %s%s' % ('ipv6 ' if item.get('addr6') else '', name)
+            if state == 'present':
+                if not any(port is None or entry.get('udp_port') == port for entry in matches):
+                    for entry in matches:
+                        actual_port = entry.get('udp_port')
+                        commands.append('no ' + prefix + (' udp-port %s' % actual_port if actual_port else ''))
+                    commands.append(prefix + (' udp-port %s' % port if port else ''))
+            else:
+                for entry in matches:
+                    if port is None or entry.get('udp_port') == port:
+                        actual_port = entry.get('udp_port')
+                        commands.append('no ' + prefix + (' udp-port %s' % actual_port if actual_port else ''))
+        elif dest == 'facility':
+            current_facility = current[0]['facility'] if current else 'user'
+            facility = item.get('facility')
+            if state == 'present' and current_facility != facility:
+                commands.append('logging facility %s' % facility)
+            elif state == 'absent' and current_facility != 'user' and (facility is None or current_facility == facility):
+                commands.append('no logging facility')
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            active = current[0].get('level', set()) if current else set()
+            levels = item['level']
+            if state == 'present':
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(levels, active)
+                commands.extend('logging buffered %s' % level for level in sorted(adds))
+            else:
+                commands.extend('no logging buffered %s' % level for level in sorted(levels & active))
+        elif dest == 'console':
+            level = item.get('level')
+            if state == 'present' and (not current or (level and current[0].get('level') != level)):
+                commands.append('logging console' + (' %s' % level if level else ''))
+            elif state == 'absent' and current and (not level or current[0].get('level') == level):
+                commands.append('no logging console' + (' %s' % level if level else ''))
+        else:
+            command = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging %s' % dest
+            if state == 'present' and not current:
+                commands.append(command)
+            elif state == 'absent' and current:
+                commands.append('no ' + command)
+    return commands
+
+
+def main():
+    item_spec = dict(
+        dest=dict(type='str', choices=['host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence', 'rfc5424', 'on', 'facility']),
+        name=dict(type='str'), udp_port=dict(type='int'), facility=dict(type='str'),
+        level=dict(type='str', choices=sorted(LEVELS)),
+        state=dict(type='str', choices=['present', 'absent']))
+    argument_spec = item_spec.copy()
+    argument_spec['state'] = dict(type='str', default='present', choices=['present', 'absent'])
+    argument_spec['aggregate'] = dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=item_spec)
+    argument_spec['check_running_config'] = dict(type='bool', default=True,
+        fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG']))
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+# Copyright: (c) Ansible Project
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+import importlib
+
+import pytest
+
+from units.compat.mock import patch
+from units.modules.utils import set_module_args
+from .icx_module import TestICXModule
+
+
+def logging_module():
+    # An absent module must fail as a test assertion, before behavior is tested.
+    try:
+        return importlib.import_module('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging')
+    except ImportError:
+        pytest.fail('icx_logging module is missing')
+
+
+class Params(object):
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+        self.params = kwargs
+
+    def fail_json(self, **kwargs):
+        raise ValueError(kwargs['msg'])
+
+
+def test_aggregate_normalizes_ipv6_facility_and_buffered_levels():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    module = Params(aggregate=[
+        {'facility': 'local0'},
+        {'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'udp_port': 5514},
+        {'dest': 'buffered', 'level': 'alerts'}],
+        dest=None, name=None, udp_port=None, facility=None, level=None, state='present')
+    want = logging.map_params_to_obj(module)
+    assert want[0]['dest'] == 'facility'
+    assert want[1]['addr6'] is True
+    assert want[1]['udp_port'] == '5514'
+    assert want[2]['level'] == {'alerts'}
+    assert want[2]['name'] is None
+    assert want[2]['udp_port'] is None
+
+
+def test_required_host_name_and_buffered_level():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    for dest, missing in [('host', 'name'), ('buffered', 'level')]:
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=missing):
+            logging.map_params_to_obj(Params(aggregate=None, dest=dest, name=None,
+                                             udp_port=None, facility=None, level=None,
+                                             state='present'))
+
+
+def test_parses_running_configuration_and_ipv6_host():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    config = '\n'.join([
+        'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514',
+        'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514',
+        'logging facility local0',
+        'logging buffered',
+        'no logging buffered alerts',
+        'logging console',
+        'logging enable rfc5424'])
+    with patch.object(logging, 'get_config', return_value=config):
+        have = logging.map_config_to_obj(Params(check_running_config=True))
+    hosts = [entry for entry in have if entry['dest'] == 'host']
+    assert [(h['name'], h['udp_port'], h['addr6']) for h in hosts] == [
+        ('192.0.2.1', '514', False), ('2001:db8::1', '5514', True)]
+    assert next(e for e in have if e['dest'] == 'facility')['facility'] == 'local0'
+    assert 'alerts' not in next(e for e in have if e['dest'] == 'buffered')['level']
+    assert any(e['dest'] == 'on' for e in have)
+    assert any(e['dest'] == 'rfc5424' for e in have)
+
+
+def test_disabled_global_logging_and_default_facility():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    with patch.object(logging, 'get_config', return_value='no logging on\nno logging console'):
+        have = logging.map_config_to_obj(Params(check_running_config=True))
+    assert not any(e['dest'] in ('on', 'console') for e in have)
+    assert next(e for e in have if e['dest'] == 'facility')['facility'] == 'user'
+
+
+def test_commands_reconcile_hosts_facility_and_levels():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    have = [
+        {'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'udp_port': '5514', 'addr6': True},
+        {'dest': 'facility', 'facility': 'local0'},
+        {'dest': 'buffered', 'level': {'alerts', 'errors'}}]
+    want = [
+        {'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'udp_port': None, 'addr6': True, 'state': 'absent'},
+        {'dest': 'host', 'name': '192.0.2.2', 'udp_port': '514', 'addr6': False, 'state': 'present'},
+        {'dest': 'facility', 'facility': 'local0', 'state': 'absent'},
+        {'dest': 'buffered', 'level': {'alerts'}, 'state': 'absent'},
+        {'dest': 'buffered', 'level': {'debugging'}, 'state': 'present'}]
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((want, have)) == [
+        'no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514',
+        'logging host 192.0.2.2 udp-port 514',
+        'no logging facility',
+        'no logging buffered alerts',
+        'logging buffered debugging']
+
+
+def test_simple_disable_commands_are_idempotent():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    have = [{'dest': 'console'}, {'dest': 'on'}, {'dest': 'persistence'}, {'dest': 'rfc5424'}]
+    want = [{'dest': d, 'state': 'absent'} for d in ('console', 'on', 'persistence', 'rfc5424')]
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((want, have)) == [
+        'no logging console', 'no logging on', 'no logging persistence', 'no logging enable rfc5424']
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((want, [])) == []
+
+
+class TestICXLoggingModule(TestICXModule):
+    module = None
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).setUp()
+        self.module = logging_module()
+        self.config_patch = patch.object(self.module, 'get_config', return_value='logging facility local0\nlogging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514')
+        self.load_patch = patch.object(self.module, 'load_config')
+        self.config_patch.start()
+        self.load_config = self.load_patch.start()
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.config_patch.stop()
+        self.load_patch.stop()
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).tearDown()
+
+    def test_aggregate_generates_only_needed_commands(self):
+        set_module_args({'aggregate': [
+            {'facility': 'local0'},
+            {'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'udp_port': 5514},
+            {'dest': 'host', 'name': '192.0.2.3', 'udp_port': 514}]})
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging host 192.0.2.3 udp-port 514'])
+
+    def test_repeat_run_reports_unchanged(self):
+        set_module_args({'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'udp_port': 5514})
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+
+def test_host_port_change_removes_old_entry_before_adding_new_one():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    want = [{'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'addr6': True,
+             'udp_port': '5515', 'state': 'present'}]
+    have = [{'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'addr6': True,
+             'udp_port': '5514'}]
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((want, have)) == [
+        'no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514',
+        'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5515']
+
+
+def test_facility_can_be_cleared_without_its_current_name():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    item = logging.map_params_to_obj(Params(aggregate=None, dest='facility',
+        facility=None, name=None, udp_port=None, level=None, state='absent'))
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((item, [
+        {'dest': 'facility', 'facility': 'local7'}])) == ['no logging facility']
+
+
+def test_buffered_disabled_level_can_be_reenabled():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    with patch.object(logging, 'get_config', return_value='logging buffered\nno logging buffered alerts'):
+        have = logging.map_config_to_obj(Params(check_running_config=True))
+    want = [{'dest': 'buffered', 'level': {'alerts'}, 'state': 'present'}]
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((want, have)) == ['logging buffered alerts']
+
+
+def test_invalid_ipv6_host_is_rejected():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='IPv6'):
+        logging.map_params_to_obj(Params(aggregate=None, dest='host',
+            name='2001:db8:::1', udp_port=None, facility=None, level=None,
+            state='present'))
+
+
+class TestICXLoggingCheckMode(TestICXModule):
+    module = None
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super(TestICXLoggingCheckMode, self).setUp()
+        self.module = logging_module()
+        self.config_patch = patch.object(self.module, 'get_config', return_value='no logging on')
+        self.load_patch = patch.object(self.module, 'load_config')
+        self.config_patch.start()
+        self.load_config = self.load_patch.start()
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.config_patch.stop()
+        self.load_patch.stop()
+        super(TestICXLoggingCheckMode, self).tearDown()
+
+    def test_check_mode_reports_commands_without_loading(self):
+        set_module_args({'dest': 'on', '_ansible_check_mode': True})
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging on'])
+        self.load_config.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_console_level_is_parsed_and_reconciled():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    with patch.object(logging, 'get_config', return_value='logging console alerts'):
+        have = logging.map_config_to_obj(Params(check_running_config=True))
+    assert next(entry for entry in have if entry['dest'] == 'console')['level'] == 'alerts'
+    want = logging.map_params_to_obj(Params(aggregate=None, dest='console',

+#!/usr/bin/python
+# Copyright: Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1', 'status': ['preview'], 'supported_by': 'community'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = '''
+---
+module: icx_logging
+version_added: "2.9"
+short_description: Manage logging on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches
+description:
+  - Configure ICX logging destinations, facilities and buffered levels.
+author: Ansible Project
+options:
+  dest:
+    description: Logging destination or feature.
+    type: str
+    choices: [host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424, on, facility]
+  name:
+    description: Syslog host name or IP address. Required for host destinations.
+    type: str
+  udp_port:
+    description: UDP port for a syslog host.
+    type: int
+  facility:
+    description: Syslog facility to set or clear.
+    type: str
+  level:
+    description: Buffered logging severity level. Required for buffered destinations.
+    type: str
+    choices: [alerts, critical, debugging, emergencies, errors, informational, notifications, warnings]
+  aggregate:
+    description: List of logging settings to reconcile in one operation.
+    type: list
+    elements: dict
+    suboptions:
+      dest:
+        type: str
+        choices: [host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424, on, facility]
+      name:
+        type: str
+      udp_port:
+        type: int
+      facility:
+        type: str
+      level:
+        type: str
+        choices: [alerts, critical, debugging, emergencies, errors, informational, notifications, warnings]
+      state:
+        type: str
+        choices: [present, absent]
+  state:
+    description: Desired state of the specified setting.
+    type: str
+    default: present
+    choices: [present, absent]
+  check_running_config:
+    description: Compare desired settings with the running configuration.
+    type: bool
+    default: true
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Configure an IPv6 syslog destination
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: host
+    name: '2001:db8::1'
+    udp_port: 5514
+
+- name: Configure facility and buffered level together
+  icx_logging:
+    aggregate:
+      - facility: local0
+      - dest: buffered
+        level: alerts
+'''
+
+RETURN = '''
+commands:
+  description: Configuration commands sent to the switch.
+  returned: always
+  type: list
+  sample: ['logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514']
+'''
+
+import re
+from ipaddress import ip_address
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule, env_fallback
+from ansible.module_utils.network.icx.icx import get_config, load_config
+
+LEVELS = frozenset(('alerts', 'critical', 'debugging', 'emergencies', 'errors',
+                    'informational', 'notifications', 'warnings'))
+
+
+def count_terms(check, param=None):
+    return sum(check.get(key) is not None for key in (param or check))
+
+
+def search_obj_in_list(name, lst):
+    for obj in lst:
+        if obj.get('name') == name:
+            return obj
+    return None
+
+
+def diff_in_list(want, have):
+    return set(want) - set(have), set(have) - set(want)
+
+
+def check_required_if(module, spec, param):
+    for key, value, required in spec:
+        if param.get(key) == value:
+            for field in required:
+                if not param.get(field):
+                    module.fail_json(msg='%s is required when %s is %s' % (field, key, value))
+
+
+def _is_ipv6(value):
+    try:
+        return ip_address(value).version == 6
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+
+
+def map_params_to_obj(module, required_if=None):
+    required_if = required_if or [('dest', 'host', ['name']),
+                                  ('dest', 'buffered', ['level']),
+                                  ('dest', 'facility', ['facility'])]
+    params = module.params
+    entries = params.get('aggregate') or [params]
+    result = []
+    for entry in entries:
+        item = {key: entry.get(key) if entry.get(key) is not None else params.get(key)
+                for key in ('dest', 'name', 'udp_port', 'facility', 'level', 'state')}
+        if item['dest'] is None and item['facility'] is not None:
+            item['dest'] = 'facility'
+        if item['dest'] is None:
+            module.fail_json(msg='dest or facility is required')
+        if not (item['dest'] == 'facility' and item.get('state') == 'absent'):
+            check_required_if(module, required_if, item)
+        item['state'] = item['state'] or 'present'
+        if item['dest'] == 'host':
+            if ':' in item['name'] and not _is_ipv6(item['name']):
+                module.fail_json(msg='invalid IPv6 host address: %s' % item['name'])
+            item['addr6'] = _is_ipv6(item['name'])
+            item['udp_port'] = str(item['udp_port']) if item['udp_port'] is not None else None
+        else:
+            item['name'] = None
+            item['udp_port'] = None
+            item['addr6'] = False
+        if item['dest'] == 'buffered':
+            item['level'] = set(item['level']) if isinstance(item['level'], (list, set, tuple)) else {item['level']}
+            if not item['level'].issubset(LEVELS):
+                module.fail_json(msg='invalid buffered logging level')
+        elif item['dest'] != 'console':
+            item['level'] = None
+        result.append(item)
+    return result
+
+
+def parse_port(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host':
+        match = re.search(r'\budp-port\s+(\d+)\b', line)
+        return match.group(1) if match else None
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_name(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host':
+        match = re.match(r'^logging host (?:ipv6 )?(\S+)', line.strip())
+        return match.group(1) if match else None
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_address(line, dest):
+    return dest == 'host' and bool(re.match(r'^logging host ipv6 \S+', line.strip()))
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    data = get_config(module, flags=['| include logging'],
+                      compare=module.params.get('check_running_config'))
+    obj = []
+    facility = 'user'
+    buffered = None
+    disabled = set()
+    global_off = False
+    for raw in data.splitlines():
+        line = raw.strip()
+        if line.startswith('logging host '):
+            obj.append(dict(dest='host', name=parse_name(line, 'host'),
+                            udp_port=parse_port(line, 'host'), addr6=parse_address(line, 'host')))
+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):
+            facility = line.split(None, 2)[2]
+        elif line == 'no logging facility':
+            facility = 'user'
+        elif line == 'no logging on':
+            global_off = True
+        elif line == 'logging on':
+            global_off = False
+        elif line == 'logging buffered':
+            buffered = set(LEVELS)
+        elif line.startswith('logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[-1]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                if buffered is None:
+                    buffered = set()
+                buffered.add(level)
+        elif line == 'no logging buffered':
+            buffered = None
+        elif line.startswith('no logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[-1]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                disabled.add(level)
+                if buffered is not None:
+                    buffered.discard(level)
+        elif re.match(r'^logging console(?: \S+)?$', line):
+            parts = line.split()
+            obj.append(dict(dest='console', level=parts[2] if len(parts) == 3 else None))
+        elif line == 'logging persistence':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='persistence'))
+        elif line == 'logging enable rfc5424':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='rfc5424'))
+    if buffered is not None:
+        obj.append(dict(dest='buffered', level=buffered - disabled))
+    obj.append(dict(dest='facility', facility=facility))
+    if not global_off:
+        obj.append(dict(dest='on'))
+    return obj
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    for item in want:
+        dest = item['dest']
+        state = item.get('state', 'present')
+        current = [entry for entry in have if entry['dest'] == dest]
+        if dest == 'host':
+            name = item['name']
+            matches = [entry for entry in current if entry.get('name') == name and
+                       entry.get('addr6', False) == item.get('addr6', False)]
+            port = item.get('udp_port')
+            prefix = 'logging host %s%s' % ('ipv6 ' if item.get('addr6') else '', name)
+            if state == 'present':
+                if not any(port is None or entry.get('udp_port') == port for entry in matches):
+                    for entry in matches:
+                        actual_port = entry.get('udp_port')
+                        commands.append('no ' + prefix + (' udp-port %s' % actual_port if actual_port else ''))
+                    commands.append(prefix + (' udp-port %s' % port if port else ''))
+            else:
+                for entry in matches:
+                    if port is None or entry.get('udp_port') == port:
+                        actual_port = entry.get('udp_port')
+                        commands.append('no ' + prefix + (' udp-port %s' % actual_port if actual_port else ''))
+        elif dest == 'facility':
+            current_facility = current[0]['facility'] if current else 'user'
+            facility = item.get('facility')
+            if state == 'present' and current_facility != facility:
+                commands.append('logging facility %s' % facility)
+            elif state == 'absent' and current_facility != 'user' and (facility is None or current_facility == facility):
+                commands.append('no logging facility')
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            active = current[0].get('level', set()) if current else set()
+            levels = item['level']
+            if state == 'present':
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(levels, active)
+                commands.extend('logging buffered %s' % level for level in sorted(adds))
+            else:
+                commands.extend('no logging buffered %s' % level for level in sorted(levels & active))
+        elif dest == 'console':
+            level = item.get('level')
+            if state == 'present' and (not current or (level and current[0].get('level') != level)):
+                commands.append('logging console' + (' %s' % level if level else ''))
+            elif state == 'absent' and current and (not level or current[0].get('level') == level):
+                commands.append('no logging console' + (' %s' % level if level else ''))
+        else:
+            command = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging %s' % dest
+            if state == 'present' and not current:
+                commands.append(command)
+            elif state == 'absent' and current:
+                commands.append('no ' + command)
+    return commands
+
+
+def main():
+    item_spec = dict(
+        dest=dict(type='str', choices=['host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence', 'rfc5424', 'on', 'facility']),
+        name=dict(type='str'), udp_port=dict(type='int'), facility=dict(type='str'),
+        level=dict(type='str', choices=sorted(LEVELS)),
+        state=dict(type='str', choices=['present', 'absent']))
+    argument_spec = item_spec.copy()
+    argument_spec['state'] = dict(type='str', default='present', choices=['present', 'absent'])
+    argument_spec['aggregate'] = dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=item_spec)
+    argument_spec['check_running_config'] = dict(type='bool', default=True,
+        fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG']))
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+# Copyright: (c) Ansible Project
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+import importlib
+
+import pytest
+
+from units.compat.mock import patch
+from units.modules.utils import set_module_args
+from .icx_module import TestICXModule
+
+
+def logging_module():
+    # An absent module must fail as a test assertion, before behavior is tested.
+    try:
+        return importlib.import_module('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging')
+    except ImportError:
+        pytest.fail('icx_logging module is missing')
+
+
+class Params(object):
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+        self.params = kwargs
+
+    def fail_json(self, **kwargs):
+        raise ValueError(kwargs['msg'])
+
+
+def test_aggregate_normalizes_ipv6_facility_and_buffered_levels():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    module = Params(aggregate=[
+        {'facility': 'local0'},
+        {'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'udp_port': 5514},
+        {'dest': 'buffered', 'level': 'alerts'}],
+        dest=None, name=None, udp_port=None, facility=None, level=None, state='present')
+    want = logging.map_params_to_obj(module)
+    assert want[0]['dest'] == 'facility'
+    assert want[1]['addr6'] is True
+    assert want[1]['udp_port'] == '5514'
+    assert want[2]['level'] == {'alerts'}
+    assert want[2]['name'] is None
+    assert want[2]['udp_port'] is None
+
+
+def test_required_host_name_and_buffered_level():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    for dest, missing in [('host', 'name'), ('buffered', 'level')]:
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=missing):
+            logging.map_params_to_obj(Params(aggregate=None, dest=dest, name=None,
+                                             udp_port=None, facility=None, level=None,
+                                             state='present'))
+
+
+def test_parses_running_configuration_and_ipv6_host():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    config = '\n'.join([
+        'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514',
+        'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514',
+        'logging facility local0',
+        'logging buffered',
+        'no logging buffered alerts',
+        'logging console',
+        'logging enable rfc5424'])
+    with patch.object(logging, 'get_config', return_value=config):
+        have = logging.map_config_to_obj(Params(check_running_config=True))
+    hosts = [entry for entry in have if entry['dest'] == 'host']
+    assert [(h['name'], h['udp_port'], h['addr6']) for h in hosts] == [
+        ('192.0.2.1', '514', False), ('2001:db8::1', '5514', True)]
+    assert next(e for e in have if e['dest'] == 'facility')['facility'] == 'local0'
+    assert 'alerts' not in next(e for e in have if e['dest'] == 'buffered')['level']
+    assert any(e['dest'] == 'on' for e in have)
+    assert any(e['dest'] == 'rfc5424' for e in have)
+
+
+def test_disabled_global_logging_and_default_facility():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    with patch.object(logging, 'get_config', return_value='no logging on\nno logging console'):
+        have = logging.map_config_to_obj(Params(check_running_config=True))
+    assert not any(e['dest'] in ('on', 'console') for e in have)
+    assert next(e for e in have if e['dest'] == 'facility')['facility'] == 'user'
+
+
+def test_commands_reconcile_hosts_facility_and_levels():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    have = [
+        {'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'udp_port': '5514', 'addr6': True},
+        {'dest': 'facility', 'facility': 'local0'},
+        {'dest': 'buffered', 'level': {'alerts', 'errors'}}]
+    want = [
+        {'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'udp_port': None, 'addr6': True, 'state': 'absent'},
+        {'dest': 'host', 'name': '192.0.2.2', 'udp_port': '514', 'addr6': False, 'state': 'present'},
+        {'dest': 'facility', 'facility': 'local0', 'state': 'absent'},
+        {'dest': 'buffered', 'level': {'alerts'}, 'state': 'absent'},
+        {'dest': 'buffered', 'level': {'debugging'}, 'state': 'present'}]
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((want, have)) == [
+        'no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514',
+        'logging host 192.0.2.2 udp-port 514',
+        'no logging facility',
+        'no logging buffered alerts',
+        'logging buffered debugging']
+
+
+def test_simple_disable_commands_are_idempotent():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    have = [{'dest': 'console'}, {'dest': 'on'}, {'dest': 'persistence'}, {'dest': 'rfc5424'}]
+    want = [{'dest': d, 'state': 'absent'} for d in ('console', 'on', 'persistence', 'rfc5424')]
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((want, have)) == [
+        'no logging console', 'no logging on', 'no logging persistence', 'no logging enable rfc5424']
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((want, [])) == []
+
+
+class TestICXLoggingModule(TestICXModule):
+    module = None
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).setUp()
+        self.module = logging_module()
+        self.config_patch = patch.object(self.module, 'get_config', return_value='logging facility local0\nlogging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514')
+        self.load_patch = patch.object(self.module, 'load_config')
+        self.config_patch.start()
+        self.load_config = self.load_patch.start()
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.config_patch.stop()
+        self.load_patch.stop()
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).tearDown()
+
+    def test_aggregate_generates_only_needed_commands(self):
+        set_module_args({'aggregate': [
+            {'facility': 'local0'},
+            {'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'udp_port': 5514},
+            {'dest': 'host', 'name': '192.0.2.3', 'udp_port': 514}]})
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging host 192.0.2.3 udp-port 514'])
+
+    def test_repeat_run_reports_unchanged(self):
+        set_module_args({'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'udp_port': 5514})
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+
+def test_host_port_change_removes_old_entry_before_adding_new_one():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    want = [{'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'addr6': True,
+             'udp_port': '5515', 'state': 'present'}]
+    have = [{'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'addr6': True,
+             'udp_port': '5514'}]
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((want, have)) == [
+        'no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514',
+        'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5515']
+
+
+def test_facility_can_be_cleared_without_its_current_name():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    item = logging.map_params_to_obj(Params(aggregate=None, dest='facility',
+        facility=None, name=None, udp_port=None, level=None, state='absent'))
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((item, [
+        {'dest': 'facility', 'facility': 'local7'}])) == ['no logging facility']
+
+
+def test_buffered_disabled_level_can_be_reenabled():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    with patch.object(logging, 'get_config', return_value='logging buffered\nno logging buffered alerts'):
+        have = logging.map_config_to_obj(Params(check_running_config=True))
+    want = [{'dest': 'buffered', 'level': {'alerts'}, 'state': 'present'}]
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((want, have)) == ['logging buffered alerts']
+
+
+def test_invalid_ipv6_host_is_rejected():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='IPv6'):
+        logging.map_params_to_obj(Params(aggregate=None, dest='host',
+            name='2001:db8:::1', udp_port=None, facility=None, level=None,
+            state='present'))
+
+
+class TestICXLoggingCheckMode(TestICXModule):
+    module = None
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super(TestICXLoggingCheckMode, self).setUp()
+        self.module = logging_module()
+        self.config_patch = patch.object(self.module, 'get_config', return_value='no logging on')
+        self.load_patch = patch.object(self.module, 'load_config')
+        self.config_patch.start()
+        self.load_config = self.load_patch.start()
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.config_patch.stop()
+        self.load_patch.stop()
+        super(TestICXLoggingCheckMode, self).tearDown()
+
+    def test_check_mode_reports_commands_without_loading(self):
+        set_module_args({'dest': 'on', '_ansible_check_mode': True})
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging on'])
+        self.load_config.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_console_level_is_parsed_and_reconciled():
+    logging = logging_module()
+    with patch.object(logging, 'get_config', return_value='logging console alerts'):
+        have = logging.map_config_to_obj(Params(check_running_config=True))
+    assert next(entry for entry in have if entry['dest'] == 'console')['level'] == 'alerts'
+    want = logging.map_params_to_obj(Params(aggregate=None, dest='console',
+        name=None, udp_port=None, facility=None, level='alerts', state='present'))
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((want, have)) == []
+    want[0]['state'] = 'absent'
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((want, have)) == ['no logging console alerts']
